label: intake-weather-gusty
note: Not a recording: the answer the Super tier is expected to give for a forecast sentence the grammar cannot read (no unit next to the number). Written by hand so the held -> approve -> hold path can be tested offline.

label: intake-weather-calm
needle: Calm and clear over the harbor
note: Within every limit: nothing to hold, so nothing is held for a person either.

label: intake-incident-midtown
needle: Three-alarm blaze tearing through a Midtown office tower
note: A news sentence with the address in prose. The address exists in configs/airspace/nyc_addresses.json, so the model's answer geocodes and is held for a person.

label: intake-incident-invented
needle: Fire crews responding to a building near the river
note: An address that is not in the gazetteer. Code discards it (intake_unreadable) instead of holding it - a made-up place is not a place.

label: intake-none
note: Irrelevant news. kind none is a valid answer: it is ledgered as read and changes nothing.

label: intake-weather-forever
needle: Gale warning in effect until further notice
note: A window the model made up far past any real forecast. Code clamps it to the horizon (now + 4 x hold_default_ticks) before the card is raised, so a person never confirms a hold that outlives the day.
